nodes.title: How to Detail
widgets_values:
1. Load an image (PNG recommended), disable the `Detailer` and 'Run' to get as much of the original image generation details as possible: model, lora, steps, sample, scheduler, seed, positive and negative prompts too. When we will add the mask the source image will be switched to a temporary `clipspace` image that will have none of the metadata, so setting it manually is required. 2. Enable the Detailer. Doing so will enable ALL the Models and Detailers, you will need to narrow the list down.
Select the expected model (01a toggles), set the parameters to match the original generation (only enable one model type). Set the LoRA and trigger words if possible to get as close as possible to the initial generation. 3. Select the `Simple Readable Metadata-SG` and from the `...` menu select the `Open in Mask Editor` option, draw your mask(s). Masks must be for the same topic that you will want the detailer to generated (ie, "face", "hand", ...). Also depending on the size of the object to regenerate, the `denoise` might have to be higher for some objects, so be ready for some trial and error. Of note, the editor allows us to draw elements, which might be required to attempt some inpainting (attempting to add components that do not exist in the original). **Note:** The positive prompt displayed is likely to also include the negative prompt (an issue with the custom node). 4. Select what to detail from the provided sub-list (01b) or modify the "Custom" entry (01b00) to match your needs. 5. Modify the exposed parameters of the "Detailer" in particular the `denoise` and cycles parameters. 6. Hit `Run` and decide if you like the result or want to try again with different parameters. 7. Use the saved image as the input to the next run to fix another component.
